identity.zh: 杰哥 AI 实验室由发起人、行业专家、AI 专家和项目伙伴组成，以项目制协作开展工作坊与咨询。源于医疗科技，服务跨行业的非技术学员、企业负责人及部门负责人，通过痛点挖掘、实验验证与价值实现，看清 AI 的具体业务价值。
identity.en: Jie’s AI Lab brings together its founder, industry specialists, AI specialists and project partners for project-based workshops and consulting. Rooted in healthcare technology, it serves non-technical learners, business leaders and department heads across industries through problem discovery, experiments and value validation.

products.zh: 半天沙龙：建立 AI 认知，通过场景讨论发现值得尝试的问题。
products.en: Half-day Salon: develop AI understanding and identify useful questions through scenario discussions.

products.zh: 1 天 Skill 工作坊：围绕一个问题或技术，完成可复用的 Skill 与操作流程。
products.en: One-day Skill Workshop: build a reusable skill and workflow around one problem or technique.

products.zh: 2 天 1 夜 Hackathon 工作坊：共创 MVP，完成演示和关键能力验证。
products.en: Two-day, one-night Hackathon: co-create an MVP, demonstrate it and validate key capabilities.

products.zh: 5 天 BootCamp：以实际功能验证满足共同约定的需求，形成可继续推进部署使用的成果；不承诺无条件上线。
products.en: Five-day BootCamp: validate actual functionality against agreed needs and produce outputs ready for further deployment work; unconditional launch is not promised.

products.zh: 3 个月组织陪跑：组合工作坊与项目咨询，持续复盘和推进业务应用。
products.en: Three-month Organisational Support: combine workshops and project consulting to review progress and advance business applications.

commonFaq.zh: 非技术人员可以参加吗？
可以。工作坊面向非技术学员、企业负责人及部门负责人，从业务问题和已有材料开始；具体工具与任务难度按参与者和验收目标确定。
commonFaq.en: Yes. Workshops serve non-technical learners, business leaders and department heads. Activities start with business problems and existing materials; tools and task complexity are chosen for participants and acceptance goals.

commonFaq.zh: 如果实验失败，算不算成果？
commonFaq.en: Does an unsuccessful experiment still produce an outcome?

commonFaq.zh: 允许失败。确认不可行的路径、AI 能力边界和需要补充的材料，以及澄清真实需求，都可形成阶段成果；开营前共同约定验收标准。
commonFaq.en: Failure is allowed. Identifying infeasible approaches, capability limits, missing materials and clearer requirements can be stage outcomes. Acceptance criteria are agreed before the workshop.

commonFaq.zh: 请先整理业务问题、参与部门、可用的脱敏材料和希望验证的目标，再查看首页合作咨询。飞书合作登记入口目前尚未开放，按钮保持禁用；开放后可通过该入口登记。
commonFaq.en: Prepare your business question, participating departments, available anonymised materials and validation goals, then visit the homepage consultation section. The Feishu registration link is not yet available and its button remains disabled; registration will be possible once it opens.

title.zh: 医疗器械 AI 解决方案与工作坊
title.en: Medical device AI solutions and workshops

description.zh: 从医疗器械企业的生产、供应链、市场情报与组织协同问题出发，开展 AI 实验。了解威高骨科工作坊的真实阶段成果、服务方式与验证边界。
description.en: Explore AI experiments for medical device production, supply chains, market intelligence and collaboration, with documented Weigao workshop outcomes and clear validation boundaries.

intro.zh: 医疗器械 AI 解决方案从一个具体业务问题开始。我们通过行业专家与 AI 专家协作，用工作坊验证场景、功能和可行路径，再决定是否值得继续投入。
intro.en: Medical device AI solutions begin with a specific business problem. Industry and AI specialists work together to test scenarios, functionality and feasibility in workshops before deciding whether further investment is justified.

heading.zh: 哪些业务场景值得先验证？
heading.en: Which business scenarios can be tested first?

text.zh: 可从生产运营与供应链、政策准入与市场情报、经营费用与决策分析、组织协同与管理自动化中选择任务。这些方向见于威高骨科的工作坊记录，具体方案仍需根据企业流程、数据权限和验收需求确定。
text.en: Potential tasks include production and supply chains, policy access and market intelligence, expenses and decision analysis, and collaboration and management automation. These areas appear in the Weigao workshop record; each solution still depends on company workflows, data permissions and acceptance needs.

heading.zh: 威高骨科：可引用的阶段事实

text.zh: 2026 年 8 月 7–8 日，25 名参与者来自 9 个部门，完成 39 件作品；21 件进入业务成果池，8 件优先继续推进。工作坊使用脱敏数据与案例。报道建议后续选择 2–3 个高价值场景试点，这些数字不代表全部已完成生产部署。详细记录和无境创新原文见下方案例。
text.en: On 7–8 August 2026, 25 participants from nine departments created 39 works; 21 entered the business-results pool and eight were prioritised for further development. Anonymised data and cases were used. The report recommends piloting two or three high-value scenarios next; these figures do not establish production deployment. See the case below for details and the original Infynova report.

faq.zh: 是否提供医疗诊断或已认证的器械产品？
faq.en: Does this offer medical diagnosis or certified device products?

faq.zh: 本页介绍企业业务工作流的实验与培训，没有医疗诊断服务、已认证器械产品或临床效果的主张。具体任务由业务专家与 AI 专家共同定义，并保留人工确认和继续试点条件。
faq.en: This page describes business-workflow experiments and training. It makes no claim of medical diagnosis services, certified devices or clinical outcomes. Business and AI specialists define tasks together, with human review and conditions for further pilots.

title.zh: 医药 AI 解决方案与医药 AI 工作坊

description.zh: 面向医药流通、医药科技与医疗器械企业，通过 AI 工作坊澄清需求、验证业务场景。查看国润医疗、保钰鑫医疗、国药数科的客户记录与来源。
description.en: AI workshops for healthcare distribution, technology and medical device businesses. Clarify needs and test scenarios with source-linked Guorun, Baoyuxin and Guoyao Shuke records.

intro.zh: 医药 AI 解决方案围绕供应链、岗位工作和跨部门协作展开。先让企业负责人、部门负责人和非技术学员一起定义问题，再用脱敏样本验证 AI 是否能支持真实任务。
intro.en: Healthcare AI solutions focus on supply chains, role-specific work and cross-department collaboration. Business leaders, department heads and non-technical learners first define the problem, then use anonymised samples to test whether AI can support real tasks.

heading.zh: 医药流通：从管理议题到实践
heading.en: Healthcare distribution: from management questions to practice

text.zh: 国润医疗的客户报道记录了 41 名中高层管理者参加 AI 赋能工作坊；保钰鑫医疗两天一夜的工作坊形成 42 个作品。作品数量是学习与实践记录，不代表已测得效率提升、投资回报或完成部署。
text.en: Guorun Medical’s report records 41 participating managers. Baoyuxin Medical’s two-day, one-night workshop produced 42 works. These counts document learning and practice; they do not establish measured efficiency gains, return on investment or deployment.

heading.zh: 医药科技：跨部门共学共创
heading.en: Healthcare technology: collaborative learning across teams

text.zh: 国药数科的报道记录了认知、体验、创作和路演，以及跨部门、跨企业的协同共创。具体产品功能、价值测算和部署验收仍待真实材料补充。客户关系来自提供的合作记录，原文机构名称与关联边界在案例中披露。
text.en: Guoyao Shuke’s reports describe understanding, exploration, creation and presentations, including collaboration across departments and companies. Product functionality, value assessments and deployment acceptance await further project materials. Client relationships come from supplied collaboration records; original organisation names and attribution limits are disclosed in each case.

heading.en: How should we choose the first experiment?

text.zh: 选择能取得脱敏样本、有人负责复核、可以共同确认验收标准的具体任务。先检查资料完整性、输出是否有依据、异常能否交回人工，再决定是否连接实际业务系统；不以作品数量替代价值验证。
text.en: Choose a specific task with available anonymised samples, an accountable reviewer and agreed acceptance criteria. Test completeness, evidence and exception handling before connecting business systems. Output counts do not replace value validation.

faq.zh: 医药 AI 工作坊等于生产系统上线吗？
faq.en: Does a healthcare AI workshop mean a production launch?

faq.zh: 不等于。工作坊可以形成需求澄清、操作流程、MVP 或功能验证记录。是否部署要继续确认功能、权限、数据与使用条件，并按共同确定的标准验收。
faq.en: No. Workshops may produce clearer requirements, workflows, MVPs or functionality-validation records. Deployment requires further confirmation of functionality, permissions, data and operating conditions against agreed criteria.

title.zh: 企业 AI 培训与业务实战工作坊
title.en: Enterprise AI training and practical workshops

description.zh: 面向非技术学员、企业及部门负责人，提供半天沙龙、1 天 Skill、2 天 1 夜 Hackathon、5 天 BootCamp 与 3 个月组织陪跑，明确阶段交付与验收边界。
description.en: AI training for non-technical learners and business leaders: half-day Salons, Skill Workshops, Hackathons, BootCamps and three-month support with agreed stage deliverables.

intro.zh: 企业 AI 培训从业务问题出发，把认知、动手实验与阶段验收连接起来。培训适合希望看清 AI 具体业务价值的非技术学员、企业负责人和部门负责人，可围绕已明确的主题，也可共同发现值得验证的场景。
intro.en: Enterprise AI training connects understanding, hands-on experiments and stage acceptance around business problems. It serves non-technical learners, business leaders and department heads who want to understand concrete AI value, through defined topics or joint discovery of useful scenarios.

text.zh: 交付取决于形式和共同约定的目标：可以是问题清单、可复用的 Skill、操作流程、MVP 演示、功能验证记录或下一轮试点方案。每次工作坊收集并确认阶段成果；不预先承诺效率提升幅度或上线日期。
text.en: Deliverables depend on the format and agreed goals: a problem list, reusable skill, workflow, MVP demonstration, validation record or next-pilot plan. Each workshop collects and confirms stage outcomes; efficiency gains and launch dates are not promised in advance.

text.zh: 明确业务问题、参与角色、已有流程、可用的脱敏样本，以及由谁确认输出可用。专题工作坊提前准备案例和材料，验收目标在开营前共同确定。
text.en: Define the business question, participant roles, existing workflow, anonymised samples and who will judge usability. Prepare cases and materials ahead of topic-specific workshops, and agree acceptance goals before starting.

faq.zh: 5 天 BootCamp 能保证上线吗？
faq.en: Does a five-day BootCamp guarantee launch?

faq.zh: 目标是通过实际功能验证满足共同确定的需求，形成可继续推进部署使用的成果。部署条件、系统衔接和使用验收需要具体确认，5 天不等于无条件承诺上线。
faq.en: The aim is to validate actual functionality against agreed needs and create outputs that can proceed toward deployment and use. Deployment conditions, integration and acceptance require specific confirmation; five days do not guarantee an unconditional launch.
